contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Black Screen Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Black screen recovery

actions.description: It will identify physical or liquid issues

steps: Inspect your phone or tablet, charger, and USB cable for any physical damage or signs of liquid exposure.
Remove any cases or accessories that might be covering the charging port or buttons.
Examine the USB connections for any corrosion or bent pins.
Check the Liquid Damage Indicator (LDI).
Turn off your phone or tablet.
Insert the ejector tool into the small hole next to the SIM/MicroSD tray to eject the tray.
Shine a flashlight into the SIM/MicroSD slot.

actions.description: It will ensure sufficient battery power

steps: Connect your phone or tablet to its appropriate charger and let it charge for at least 1 hour.

actions.description: It will try a fresh power cycle

steps: Disconnect the phone or tablet from the charger.
Try to turn it on by pressing and holding the Power button (or Side button) for 15 to 20 seconds.
Turn off your device and reconnect it to the appropriate charger until it is fully charged.

actions.description: It will provide further assistance options

steps: Contact the Customer Support Center for further assistance.

actions.description: It will attempt to reboot the phone

steps: If there's no physical or liquid damage, force a restart on your device.
Press and hold both the Power button (or Side button) and the Volume down button simultaneously for at least 20 seconds.
If your device has a removable battery, remove the battery for 60 seconds.
Reinsert it.
